- Add a first-class `update-agent` route and `.github/prompts/agent-update.md` prompt.
- Switch `agent-update.yml` from `skill: update-agent` / `route: skill` to `prompt: agent-update` / `route: update-agent`.
- Update runtime route validation, prompt mapping, docs, and focused workflow tests.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #368

## Notes

- Main implementation direction satisfies the rubrics: it moves update off the skill path, reuses the existing prompt/route runtime contract, keeps privileged runtime code on the trusted checkout, and updates docs/tests alongside behavior.

## Findings

That means a future route-specific rubric with `applies_to: [update-agent]` would be rejected as an unsupported route.
- **INFO:** Post-merge setup guidance is present, but it could better satisfy the setup-guidance rubric by telling the runtime to include direct workflow links when the target repo is known.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #369 moves repo update off `.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md` and onto a dedicated `.github/prompts/agent-update.md` prompt.
- It adds `update-agent` as a first-class internal route, wires `agent-update.yml` to `prompt: agent-update` / `route: update-agent`, and updates runtime prompt mapping plus envelope validation.
- The change addresses issue #368, where installed repos without `.skills/update-agent` could not self-update because the old workflow failed before the agent could run.
- The implementation follows the dedicated prompt precedent from the install path in #304.

## Review
No **BLOCKING** issue is supported by the current review artifacts or live PR state. The core route/prompt implementation is sound, but two small branch changes remain before this is clean to ship.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Rubric route metadata still omits `update-agent` | WARNING | `update-agent` is now a runtime route, but `RUBRIC_ROUTE_NAMES` still lacks it, so route-specific update rubrics would be rejected or unavailable. |
| Update migration guidance is incomplete | WARNING | The docs now describe the dedicated route, but omit the #368 bootstrap caveat and the `route_overrides.skill` to `route_overrides.update-agent` policy-key migration. |
| Legacy update skill wording is stale | INFO | `.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md` still says the built-in workflow invokes this skill, which is now misleading if the skill remains only as a manual/backward-compatible path. |

## Progress
- Read all current review outputs: Claude, Codex, and rubrics review.
- Checked PR #369 conversation, linked issue #368, install precedent PR #304, current diff, inline review comments, and review threads.
- Current PR checks report `check` passing on head `f56102ec7ce458371717f289450896d51109783b`.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/docs/usage/supported-workflows.md` for the migration caveat.
- No replies were added, no comments were minimized, and no threads were resolved.
- Skipped a duplicate inline comment for the rubric allowlist gap because the existing rubrics review already covers it clearly in the PR discussion.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Rubric route metadata still omits `update-agent`</summary>

**Cause:** [`VALID_ROUTES`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f56102ec7ce458371717f289450896d51109783b/.agent/src/envelope.ts#L64-L70) and the workflow now accept `update-agent`, but [`RUBRIC_ROUTE_NAMES`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f56102ec7ce458371717f289450896d51109783b/.agent/src/rubrics.ts#L33-L44) still stops at `install` plus rubric routes.

**Candidate solutions:** Add `update-agent` to `RUBRIC_ROUTE_NAMES`, and add focused coverage showing an `applies_to: [update-agent]` rubric validates and is selected for the update route.

**Comments:** Codex and the rubrics review both flagged this. This is the highest-signal required fix.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Update migration guidance is incomplete</summary>

**Cause:** Issue #368 explicitly called out existing installed repos that already lack `.skills/update-agent`; those repos need a one-time refresh PR before the new route can help. The route rename also changes update-specific timeout/model policy keys from `skill` to `update-agent`.

**Candidate solutions:** Add a short note in the update workflow docs or PR-facing docs explaining the one-time refresh requirement and the `AGENT_TASK_TIMEOUT_POLICY` / `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` `route_overrides` key rename.

**Comments:** Claude treated this as a warning; Codex treated the bootstrap note as INFO. Synthesis treats it as WARNING because it is the main operational caveat from #368 and is safe to document directly.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Legacy update skill wording is stale</summary>

**Cause:** [`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f56102ec7ce458371717f289450896d51109783b/.skills/update-agent/SKILL.md#L26-L35) still says the built-in `agent-update.yml` workflow invokes this skill, but the PR changes that workflow to the dedicated prompt route.

**Candidate solutions:** If the skill remains, add a brief note that scheduled/manual built-in updates now use `update-agent`, while the skill applies only to explicit manual skill use.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the remaining warnings are concrete, small branch changes that are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

- [ ] Document the update migration caveats: one-time refresh PR for affected installs and `route_overrides.skill` to `route_overrides.update-agent` policy-key migration.
